item.title: Refactor order status String into OrderStatus enum
item.brief:
The `orders` crate stores an order's status as a `String` and compares string literals across the code. Refactor it to a proper type, keeping all observable behaviour identical (errors, report output and ordering, parsing).

Requirements:
- Add `src/status.rs` with `pub enum OrderStatus { Pending, Paid, Shipped, Cancelled }` deriving at least `Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash`.
- `OrderStatus::as_str(self) -> &'static str` returns lowercase names ("pending", "paid", "shipped", "cancelled"); `Display` prints the same.
- `FromStr` for `OrderStatus` with `type Err = ParseStatusError`, a public error type implementing `std::error::Error` whose message names the rejected input.
- `OrderStatus::can_transition_to(self, next: OrderStatus) -> bool` encodes the lifecycle: pending -> paid, pending -> cancelled, paid -> shipped, paid -> cancelled; nothing else.
- `Order::status` becomes an `OrderStatus`; re-export `OrderStatus` and `ParseStatusError` from the crate root; use the enum everywhere so status string literals appear only in `src/status.rs`.

Acceptance: `cargo test` passes; observable behaviour unchanged; work committed on the branch (local ship only, no push).

pr.body: Approach: src/status.rs adds OrderStatus (as_str, Display via f.pad, can_transition_to, FromStr) and ParseStatusError. Order::status is OrderStatus. Order::move_to (pub(crate)) enforces the lifecycle and builds the error as 'order N cannot be <next>: it is <current>', which matches the old messages. billing::pay, shipping::ship and Order::cancel use move_to. report::from_line parses the status and maps ParseStatusError to 'unknown status "<input>"', unchanged. report::status_counts keeps Vec<(String, usize)> and alphabetical ordering, keyed by as_str; it is not derived from the enum's Ord, which would sort by declaration order. Key files: src/status.rs, src/order.rs, src/report.rs, src/billing.rs, src/shipping.rs, src/lib.rs, tests/orders.rs, tests/status.rs. Checks: cargo test 9/9 pass; clippy -D warnings clean; fmt clean. Assumptions and limits: Order::status is a public field, so downstream callers that used it as a String will break; this is the requested change. status_counts keeps String keys. Existing functions were not given new asserts, since this is a behaviour-preserving refactor.
pr.summary: made order status a typed enum. now transitions are checked by OrderStatus::can_transition_to and status names live only in status.rs. before: status was a String compared against literals in billing, shipping and order; now: OrderStatus with identical error messages, ordering and parsing.
pr.title: Replace order status String with OrderStatus enum

risk.why: Changes the public Order::status field type, a breaking API change for callers. Behaviour is otherwise unchanged: error strings, status_counts ordering, from_line parsing and check order were all verified against base. Reviewer agt_01M88Y0MSG0ZND3Z2B0T3K3F9Z confirmed high.
